description: Was this Arc launch bundled? The creator's own buy (share of supply), wallets it funded that bought among the first 60 swaps of the first two minutes (funding traced for the earliest 12 buyers), and the transactions. Pass token or pool. $0.004 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: arc_bundle_check
